segments.action: the performer enters the ruined hall
the performer raises the lantern and begins the journey
the journey continues through rain and stone arches
the performer reaches the sealed gate
the gate opens as choir and strings surge
the performer crosses the threshold into blue firelight
the instruments fall back while the performer stands still
the performer turns toward the returning choir
the hall fills with sweeping strings and sparks
the performer lowers the lantern as dawn reaches the gate
